seriesFact: A tale back in time from Norway that spans sixteen volumes
seriesTeaser: A rich and moving historical journey begins…
description: Its a historical coming-of-age drama set in 1910s Vaterland, Kristiania in Norway
This series reflects the realities of early 20th-century life with emotional honesty and care.
This is a sweeping sixteen-book saga tracing Marie’s life from childhood to adulthood, from dusty backrooms to elegant halls, and from silence to strength.
If you love character-driven historical fiction filled with heart, courage, and vivid storytelling, Marie’s story will stay with you long after the final page.
Themes include family secrets, resilience in the face of hardship, and the quiet power of a young girl determined to find her place in the world.

The Norwegian author Sigrid Lunde is the celebrated pen name behind Jordmoren (The Midwife), a 66-volume bestseller that captivated readers across the Nordic world. With East End Lass, her unforgettable storytelling is now available in English for the first time.
